notes.title: Selanìa, our upcoming video game, is now available to be wishlisted on Steam.
notes.notes: [p]Hello little queer pack! It's a long long time, isn't it? But today we are here with a lot of news. News about [b]new games[/b]![/p][p]Currently, we are working on two different games.[/p][p]The biggest one, with the temporary name [i]Loop[/i], it will be an investigative game about relationships, violence and hope. Totally handmade with cardboard, we'll be able to show you something about this project in the [b]late[/b] [b]2026[/b].[/p][p]The second, a smaller project named [i]Selanìa[/i], it will be a narrative cozy game about care, community, and change.[/p][p][i]Selanìa[/i] it will be out sooner, probably in the [b]spring 2026[/b], but you can check out yet the Steam page, and wishlist it if you want: it will be really helpfull, 'cause Steam promotes easily the pages with a lot of interest.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3946540/Selana/"][/dynamiclink]We'll try to give you frequent updates, and luckily a demo nearly Xmas.[/p][p]Until then: paws up, and stay furious & queer![/p][p]owof[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: non binary at Gayming Live Indie Festival!
notes.notes:
Hello dear friends.

It would appear that with "non-binary" we will be participating in the Gayming Live Indie Festival!

From Sept. 30 to Oct. 14 we will be present together with other LGBTQ+ indie creators in a colorful Steam Sale Event, and we will also be at #GaymingLive23 from Oct. 6 to 8.

All info about the initiative is at: gaymingmag.com/live
If you want, you can follow gayming at the IG page @gaymingmag 🐾

(Among the interesting things about the event is the presentation of Wrestling with Emotions, which we have been waiting for in no small part ❤️).

Paws up! 🐾

See you soon (we miss you a lot <3)

owof
